anchors.statement: A Phase C generated consumer must install sc-lint through just setup and execute the configured full lint profile through just lint.
anchors.quote: a full sc-lint is installed on a consumer repo
anchors.summary: Generated consumer runs the full sc-lint profile
anchors.scope: the c-2 generated-consumer lint sprint and any plan item that edits template sc-lint setup or lint commands
anchors.deterministic_check: A generated fixture runs just setup and just lint while its receipt records sc-boundary, sc-portability, and sc-runtime.

anchors.statement: Phase C must select and validate newest stable compatible versions of rmcp, utoipa, and utoipa-axum through one runtime/template composition graph.
anchors.quote: upgrading rmcp/utopia to the latest releave version should be planned in phase-<next>
anchors.scope: the c-1 compatibility contract and c-3 runtime ecosystem upgrade sprints
anchors.deterministic_check: Cargo metadata for the runtime and generated daemon composition graph reports one reachable package identity for rmcp, utoipa, and utoipa-axum.

anchors.statement: The repository and generated template must both declare and bootstrap sc-lint 0.8.4.
anchors.quote: both repo and templates should use 0.8.4
anchors.scope: the c-1 consumer contract and c-2 template lint profile sprints
anchors.deterministic_check: The root and template sc-lint configuration require 0.8.4, and each bootstrap path installs or verifies that version.

anchors.statement: Phase C plan paths, branches, sprint identifiers, triage records, and QA evidence must use the phase identifier c.
anchors.scope: every Phase C plan item and its plan metadata
anchors.deterministic_check: A targeted repository scan of Phase C assets reports no phase-bc, bc-<n>, or ARCH-BC identifiers.

anchors.statement: Phase C planning must be maintained on a dedicated plan/phase-c worktree and proposed to develop in a separate pull request.
anchors.quote: planning should be done on a second pr to develop on a dedicated $sc-git-worktree
anchors.summary: Dedicated Phase C planning worktree and PR
anchors.scope: the Phase C plan branch, worktree, and pull request metadata
anchors.deterministic_check: Git worktree metadata records plan/phase-c separately, and its pull request targets develop.
